svg.text: Domino 6.3 GKE Network Perimeter, Webhook Firewalls, Workload Identity & KMS Security
Horizontal Layered View: Public Edge & IAP -> VPC & Master Peering Firewalls -> Workload Identity Federation -> Zero-Touch KMS IAM
LAYER 1 — EXTERNAL ACCESS CONTROL, IAP TCP FORWARDING & OUTBOUND NAT EGRESS (network.tf | node_pools.tf)
• Restricts GKE API Server (6443) to Authorized CIDRs
• NGINX LoadBalancer Exposes Only TCP :80 and :443
• Zero Public Node IPs Required for Node Debugging
• Outbound Access for Private GKE Worker Nodes
• Pulls from: quay.io, domino.tech, gcr.io, docker.io
• Private Google Access Enabled on Subnet 10.138.0.0/20
LAYER 2 — VPC SUBNETTING, CONTROL PLANE VPC PEERING & ADMISSION WEBHOOK FIREWALLS (gke.tf | nfs-instance.tf)
• Secondary Range 1: GKE Pod IPv4 CIDR Block
• Secondary Range 2: GKE Services IPv4 CIDR Block
• Optional /24 VPC Peering for NetApp Volumes (GCNV)
2B. GKE Master Control Plane Webhook Firewall (domino-gcp-gke-master-webhooks)
Source: 172.16.1.0/28 (GKE Master Peering) -> Target Tag: domino-gcp
• TCP 6443 : Kubernetes API & Custom Resource Conversion Webhooks
• TCP 8443 : NGINX Ingress Controller Validating Admission Webhook
• TCP 9443 : Cert-Manager & Domino Platform Operator Webhooks
• TCP 10250 : Kubelet API (kubectl exec, logs & metrics-server)
• TCP 15017 : Istio Sidecar Injector / Mutating Webhook
LAYER 3 — GKE WORKLOAD IDENTITY FEDERATION: KUBERNETES SAs <-> GCP IAM SERVICE ACCOUNTS (service-accounts.tf | gcr.tf)
• Bound via roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser to K8s SAs:
• Bound via roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser to K8s SAs:
3C. GCR Credential Refresher & Node Pool SAs
LAYER 4 — ZERO-TOUCH CLOUD KMS CMEK ENCRYPTION FOR GKE SECRETS & GCS BACKUPS (apis.tf | kms.tf)
4A. Cloud KMS KeyRing & CryptoKey (86,400s Daily Rotation)
• Purpose: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT | Automatic Daily Key Rotation (rotation_period = "86400s")
• Encrypts Kubernetes Secrets at rest in GKE Control Plane etcd (database_encryption = ENCRYPTED)
• Encrypts all Domino Backups & Registry Blobs in GCS (default_kms_key_name)
4B. Automated Service Agent KMS IAM Binding (Eliminates Manual Console Step)
• Enforced via depends_on before google_container_cluster and google_storage_bucket creation
